note: IMD Kolkata issues a heavy rainfall warning for Paschim Bardhaman as a monsoon depression tracks across Gangetic West Bengal.
Rainfall of 42 mm in one hour recorded at the Neamatpur substation gauge.
Gusts to 58 km/h recorded at the Sitarampur monitoring mast. No squall line developed.
Rain eases to light showers. Cumulative rainfall 121 mm over the event.
